CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

2. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

3. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

   D. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

9. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

11. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.

13. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

14. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

15. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
